name: scenario_1055
description: Tammy is reviewing a series of historical corporate and medical documents for an upcoming review session. She needs to aggregate specific action items, presentation details, and financial figures from these documents into a single calendar event.

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_2, image_4]
Query: Create a new note called 'Conti Actions'. Look at these two tables and write down the descriptions of all the tasks assigned to A. Conti that are currently in progress. Please include any shared assignments too.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to create a new note called 'Conti Actions' and extract the descriptions of all 'In progress' tasks assigned to A. Conti (including shared ones) from the provided images into the note. If the assistant misses any tasks or includes ones that are already completed, point it back to the images to correct the list. Once the note is created with the correct items, move to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_1]
Query: Now look at this agenda. Find the presentation given by G. Scherer and add its title to that same note.
Instructions: Instruct the assistant to find the title of the presentation by G. Scherer in the provided agenda and append it to the 'Conti Actions' note. If the assistant extracts the wrong presentation or asks for more details, direct it to look specifically for G. Scherer's name in the document. Once the note is updated, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 3 [provide: image_5]
Query: Check this schedule and add the name of the moderator for the OTC Review session to the note as well.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to identify the moderator for 'The OTC Review' session from the provided schedule and append their name to the 'Conti Actions' note. If the assistant asks for clarification on which session, tell it to look for the one titled 'I. THE OTC REVIEW'. Once the name is added, move on.

ROUND 4 [provide: image_3]
Query: Finally, grab the Total Sponsorship Funds amount from this agreement. I want to update my 'Historical Document Review' calendar event. Change its description to include that dollar amount along with everything we've collected in the Conti Actions note. Once you've updated the event, go ahead and delete the note.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to extract the Total Sponsorship Funds amount from the agreement, read the contents of the 'Conti Actions' note, and update the 'Historical Document Review' calendar event by putting all that aggregated information into its description, then delete the note. The assistant should notice there are multiple events with that name and ask for clarification. When it does, specify that you mean the one scheduled for next Wednesday. If it fails to delete the note after updating the event, remind it to do so. Conclude the conversation once the event is updated and the note is deleted.
